title: KS-LIT-3M: A 3.1 MILLION WORD KASHMIRI TEXT DATASET FOR LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL PRETRAINING
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of an InPage-to-Unicode converter and the curation of a text dataset for the Kashmiri language. Although the dataset includes 'religious scholarship' as a genre and the paper contains a standard ethics statement, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
